notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
I. The wall jump has received a big change, and now the player doesn't need to push against the wall to perform a Wall Jump.
II. The cooldown for throwing stones has been reduced by a small amount of time.
III. Now the "Water Walk" ability allows the player to perform jumps in water at any time during execution.
IV. The PS4 controller can now use the D-Pad buttons to play melodies and Jutsus.
V. The Egg Hatch Time cooldown has been reduced, and it only occurs when the player is in idle status.
VI. Some graphics fixes have been made for the 30fps option, small changes have been made to some sprites (layer order), and the Tutorial session now has all levels unlocked.
